# Business Continuity Tabletop

Organization: Example GmbH
Version: 0.9
Review date: June 2026
Document owner: Resilience Coordinator role

## Tabletop Exercise

The business continuity tabletop exercise tested loss of the primary office and a cloud
service outage. The Resilience Coordinator role recorded recovery time decisions, owner
actions, and follow-up tickets.

| Scenario | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| office unavailable | remote work procedure activated | exercise report |
| cloud outage | escalation workflow tested | action log |

## Follow-Up Gap

Supplier security for the backup connectivity provider is vague. The review is ad hoc
and contractual security evidence is missing.
